title: ECG hypertrophy and admission pressure: no established incremental angiographic prediction across Cleveland and VA Long Beach
abstract: Adding ECG-hypertrophy-conditioned admission blood pressure changed Cleveland-to-VA Long Beach angiographic disease Brier error by -0.000060 (joint bootstrap95% [-0.006281,0.008508];303 source,99 target). Incremental prediction was not established.
